title: CandyTop — SugarCraft
description: CandyTop: Terminal system monitor for PHP — cpu, mem, disks, net, process, containers, GPU/NPU and BMC (ipmi) boxes, a VM dashboard, 43 themes (42 ported from btop plus candy-top's own pastel) and btop-compatible config, Linux and FreeBSD collectors.
ogDescription: Terminal system monitor — cpu, memory, disk, network, process, container, GPU, BMC and VM boxes with braille graphs, gradient meters, 43 themes (42 ported from btop plus candy-top's own pastel) and btop-compatible config.
